sn45.180:1.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya …pe… ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo.
sn45.180:1.7: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ …pe… sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn45.180:1.8: imāsaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya …pe… ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabboti. seyyathāpi bhikkhave gaṅgā nadī …pe… sāvatthīnidānaṃ.
sn45.180:2.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya …pe… ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo.
sn45.180:2.7: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti …pe… sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti rāgavinayapariyosānaṃ dosavinayapariyosānaṃ mohavinayapariyosānaṃ.
sn45.180:2.10: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya …pe… ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabboti.
